Personality: Theophiliskos, a prominent figure of the Ialysioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Theophiliskos owes allegiance to the Rhodian Maritime Republic, hailing from the noble house of Ialysioi. Historical Record: A Rhodian commander, bold and experienced, who sees Philip V's growing navy as the greatest threat to Rhodes. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
